name: Business Hours Device Policy
description: At the start of business hours, verifies office PCs are online and applies the business-hours policy; flags machines that are off or blocked.

error_handler.title: Office PCs offline
error_handler.body: One or more office PCs did not come online for the business day

error_handler.title: Policy apply failed
error_handler.body: Could not apply the business-hours policy on one or more office PCs

error_handler.title: Unattended workstations
error_handler.body: Some workstations are unlocked or in an unexpected state

config.title: Business-hours policy applied
config.body: Office fleet is ready for the business day
